mapper.select: SELECT id, customer_id AS customerId, conversion_status_code AS conversionStatusCode, height, weight, selected_priority_category AS selectedPriorityCategory, history_json AS historyJson, activity_json AS activityJson, past_surgery_or_hospitalization AS pastSurgeryOrHospitalization, desired_budget_code AS desiredBudgetCode, received_at AS receivedAt FROM webform_response WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, customer_id AS customerId, conversion_status_code AS conversionStatusCode, height, weight, selected_priority_category AS selectedPriorityCategory, history_json AS historyJson, activity_json AS activityJson, past_surgery_or_hospitalization AS pastSurgeryOrHospitalization, desired_budget_code AS desiredBudgetCode, received_at AS receivedAt FROM webform_response WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id AS customerId, name, birth_date AS birthDate, gender, sales_user_id AS salesUserId FROM potential_customer WHERE id = #{customerId} UNION ALL SELECT integrated_customer_id AS customerId, name, birth_date AS birthDate, gender, sales_user_id AS salesUserId FROM integrated_customer WHERE integrated_customer_id = #{customerId} LIMIT 1

SELECT id AS coverageId, category_code AS categoryCode, coverage_name AS coverageName, unit_premium AS unitPremium, danger_priority_order AS dangerPriorityOrder FROM insurance_coverage WHERE coverage_name = #{coverageName} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO insurance_plan ( webform_response_id, plan_name, total_premium, script_data, recommendation_type_code, created_at ) VALUES ( #{webformResponseId}, #{planName}, #{totalPremium}, #{scriptData}, #{recommendationTypeCode}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
INSERT INTO insurance_plan_coverage ( plan_id, coverage_id, selected_order, applied_premium ) VALUES ( #{planId}, #{coverageId}, #{selectedOrder}, #{appliedPremium} )

INSERT INTO recommendation_log ( potential_customer_id, target_insured_type, webform_response_id, sales_user_id, recommended_category_code, total_score, recommend_reason, script_data ) VALUES ( #{potentialCustomerId}, #{targetInsuredType}, #{webformResponseId}, #{salesUserId}, #{recommendedCategoryCode}, #{totalScore}, #{recommendReason}, #{scriptData} )
